_template_featured._use: To add a featured project: copy the 3 keys below, replace 'newproject' with a short slug, fill in the values. Then add an <article class='project-card'> block in projects.html using the same data-i18n keys.
_template_featured.newproject_desc: Description of what the project does and its main features.

_template_other._use: To add an other/secondary project: copy the 1 key below, replace 'newproject' with a slug, fill in the value. Then add a <li> in the 'Other Projects' section of projects.html.

page_desc: Selection of academic and personal software development projects by Raúl Estévez.
heading: Projects
intro: Selection of academic and personal projects focused on backend development, software engineering and applied artificial intelligence.
duckyware_desc: Hardware e-commerce platform built with Python and Django. It implements database-driven catalog categories, carts with stock and discount logic, order processing, user profiles, dynamic search, and PayPal payment integration.
duckyware_tech: Python, Django, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript
onlinestore_desc: Java and JavaFX desktop application for managing customers, products, stock, and orders in an online store. It evolves from UML design to a graphical interface, using MVC architecture, MySQL persistence through JDBC and Hibernate/JPA, DAO/Factory patterns, and JUnit tests.
cs50ai_desc: Structured CS50 AI repository with 13 completed Python exercises across search, logic, uncertainty, optimization, machine learning, neural networks, and natural language processing.
cs50ai_tech: Python, AI, Machine Learning, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, NLTK, Pygame
eplant_desc: React and Redux plant store exercise from an IBM course, with product listings, plant categories, cart flow, and a GitHub Pages demo. Completed from a provided starter base.
unity_desc: Academic projects developed with Unity, focused on augmented and virtual reality experiences.
android_desc: Mobile application developed as part of academic coursework using Kotlin.
tetris_desc: Classic Tetris game implemented from scratch in Python using Pygame.
flutter_desc: Hands-on Flutter and Dart exercises from an advanced mobile development course.
smartcity_desc: IoT monitoring dashboard deployed on ThingsBoard Cloud, simulating smart city sensor data with Python.
devnet_desc: Data persistence techniques and ERP-oriented application development using C# and .NET.
bingo_desc: Automatic bingo simulator in C that generates player cards, draws random numbers, marks matches and determines the winner.
woodshop_desc: Management system for clients, products, stores and sales simulation built in Java.
fleetcontrol_desc: Fleet management application developed in C, focused on structured data handling and system-level programming.
cs50final_desc: Final project for Harvard's CS50 Introduction to Computer Science.
djangoibm_desc: Django web application for generating automated multiple-choice exams, built as IBM course final project.
ibmai_desc: Applied artificial intelligence and machine learning project developed as part of IBM's AI Engineering program.
expressbookreview_desc: Node.js and Express REST API for browsing books and managing user reviews, built from an IBM course starter base.
